below900: Collapse navigation into a keyboard-operable menu.
Stack brand, headline, copy, actions, mobile hero art, pinned pathways, and service index.
Use hero-excavation-collage-mobile.webp instead of shrinking the desktop hero.
Reduce the left ledger to a thin survey-red rule.
Convert pinned cards to a vertical stack or accessible horizontal snap list.
below640: Use two columns for the six-service index.
Keep at least 16 CSS pixels of page gutter.
Keep all touch targets at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels.
below480: Use one column for the six-service index.
Prevent text or decorative art from creating horizontal overflow.

imageFit.logo: contain; preserve intrinsic aspect ratio; never crop
imageFit.heroDesktop: contain; use the full paper field
imageFit.serviceIllustrations: contain; preserve the warm paper field
imageFit.pinnedReferences: reference only; labels and links must be native HTML

recommendedTypography.display: League Gothic, Roboto Condensed, or equivalently licensed condensed display face
recommendedTypography.body: Courier Prime or equivalently licensed readable monospaced face
recommendedTypography.ui: Barlow Condensed, Roboto Condensed, or equivalently licensed compact sans serif
recommendedTypography.handAnnotation: Caveat, Segoe Print, or equivalently licensed restrained handwriting face

motion.reducedMotionBehavior: Remove drawing animations, parallax, page wipes, and spring effects; use immediate or short opacity changes.
